ean.title: EAN / Barcode
ean.description: EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC or GTIN barcode to verify against EU Safety Gate recalls (e.g. '5054298241091').

eans.title: Batch EANs / Barcodes
eans.description: Array of EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC or GTIN barcodes for batch screening of e-commerce catalogs (e.g. ['5054298241091', '4099979071513']).

category.title: Category / Kategorie
category.description: Product category to filter alerts (e.g. 'Toys', 'Cosmetics', 'Electrical appliances', 'Motor vehicles').

query.title: Search Query / Suchbegriff
query.description: Free text search term to search across product names, brands, models, and danger descriptions (e.g. 'wooden puzzle').

childProductsOnly.title: Child & Baby Products Only
childProductsOnly.description: Filter strictly for toys, baby items, children's clothing and products intended for kids.

ageGroup.title: Child Age Group
ageGroup.description: Filter by target age group: 'baby' (0-12m), 'toddler' (1-3y), 'child' (toys/general kids), 'unknown'.

hazard.title: Child Specific Hazard
hazard.description: Filter by primary child hazard: 'choking' (small parts), 'chemical' (PFAS, phthalates), 'magnets' (flux index).

refreshData.title: Live Data Refresh
refreshData.description: If true, fetches the latest official Safety Gate XML alerts from the European Commission before querying.

maxItems.title: Maximum Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of alert items to return in the dataset (capped at 50 per run to prevent wholesale data dumping).

asins.title: Amazon ASINs
asins.description: Array of Amazon Standard Identification Numbers (ASINs, e.g. ['B08N5WRWNW', 'B09V3HN1KC']) to screen against EU safety recalls. Maximum 1,000 ASINs per run.

amazonUrls.title: Amazon Product URLs
amazonUrls.description: List of Amazon product detail page URLs or shortlinks (e.g. ['https://www.amazon.de/dp/B08N5WRWNW', 'https://amzn.to/3example']) to extract identifiers from. Maximum 1,000 URLs per run.

csvUrl.title: Catalog CSV URL
csvUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL of a remote product catalog CSV for batch recall screening (e.g. 'https://example.com/catalogs/products_2026.csv'). HTTP is rejected.

csvContent.title: Raw CSV Content
csvContent.description: Direct raw CSV file content containing product identifiers (EAN, GTIN, ASIN, SKU) for bulk screening. Maximum size: 5 MB.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Target HTTPS endpoint for real-time safety recall notifications (e.g. 'https://api.example.com/webhooks/safety-alerts' or Slack/Discord incoming webhook URLs). Must use HTTPS.

webhookFormat.title: Webhook Payload Format
webhookFormat.description: Notification payload structure: 'generic' (standard pse.alert.v1 JSON), 'slack' (Slack Block Kit), or 'discord' (Discord Embeds). Default is 'generic'.

webhookSecret.title: Webhook HMAC Secret
webhookSecret.description: Shared secret key used to compute HMAC-SHA256 signature in the X-Hub-Signature-256 header (e.g. 'whsec_5f8a9b2c3d4e...').

webhookOnlyOnMatch.title: Webhook Only On Match
webhookOnlyOnMatch.description: If true, sends webhook notifications only when product safety recall matches are found. If false, dispatches a summary for every run.
